tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18; also called Jehiah at 1Ch.15.24;
Another name of ye.i.el (יְעִיאֵל "Jeiel" H3273I)
§ Jehiah = "Jehovah lives"
doorkeeper of the ark at the time of its establishment in Jerusalem

strongs_1890.derivation: from H2421 (חָיָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will live;
